lines.text: It’s project time! Make a character walk from home to the park in ScratchJr: choose a background, start with a green flag, use arrow blocks with numbers, and share it with a friend.
Your character goes from home to the park.
Plan the path with arrows first.
In ScratchJr, tap the picture button to choose a park background.
Use arrow blocks with numbers to walk your character to the slide.
Press the green flag and show your trip.
Walk the child from home to the slide (star). Follow the path.
You made it to the park! Wheee!
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
